UI Design for working across multiple frameworks

From the story card -

A user may have multiple frameworks they want to work with.

There are two types of frameworks. Industry frameworks that we create, and custom frameworks that users create.

This card covers the experience of how users navigate between and work with multiple frameworks. How we create the frameworks if covered elsewhere.
